title: Medicaid and CHIP open data (data.medicaid.gov)
questions: total Medicaid and CHIP enrollment nationally in the latest month
Medicaid enrollment by state over time
how many adults are enrolled through the ACA Medicaid expansion
Medicaid renewals and procedural disenrollments by state
share of Medicaid enrollees in managed care by state
federal share of Medicaid expansion spending by state and quarter
Medicaid prescriptions and reimbursement for a drug by state
NADAC price of a drug over time

manual.how: Open each link in manual_download/INSTRUCTIONS.md in a browser (a JSON page of up to 8,000 rows with the request's filters) and save it under the name shown, then upload it. Without the links: open https://data.medicaid.gov/dataset/<dataset id>, use the Download button (the full CSV, display-style column names), or https://data.medicaid.gov/api/1/datastore/query/<dataset id>/0/download?format=csv (the full CSV; it takes the same conditions[...] filters). Current CMS-64 expenditure files (after fiscal year 2016) are only on https://www.medicaid.gov/medicaid/financial-management/state-expenditure-reporting-for-medicaid-chip/expenditure-reports-mbescbes (open in a browser; the site refuses scripts).

cache.why: Enrollment updates monthly and NADAC weekly; data/ is reused only within a run.

redistribution.why: data.medicaid.gov datasets carry the U.S. Public Domain label (https://www.usa.gov/publicdomain/label/1.0/); CMS data are U.S. government works (17 U.S.C. 105).

citation: Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services, {dataset}, data.medicaid.gov, retrieved {retrieved_long}.
clarify: Medicaid only, or Medicaid and CHIP together? Default: report total Medicaid and CHIP enrollment and give Medicaid and CHIP separately.
Which month: the latest (preliminary) report, or the latest updated (final) month? Default: the latest month, said to be preliminary.
Total computable spending or the federal share only? Default: both, labeled.
